text:
kevin.m: Heads-up — we need an urgent quota + capacity reservation for ND-series in northeurope for a customer PoC next week. Target: 8x ND GPUs (A100/ND equivalent) reserved in a single pool.

nina.s: what's the subscription id and the exact sku names? also, what's the deadline?

kevin.m: Subscription: 8f2a1c33-XXXX-4f2d-YYYY-9a123example. SKU we requested previously was Standard_ND40rs_v2 (or closest A100 offering). Demo is Wed 2025-11-12, so ideally reservation and quota increase by end of day Mon 2025-11-10.

raj_patel: tagging infra oncall @oncall-roster. We should check quota + regional availability. azure portal sometimes shows zero available capacity even after quota increase.

miguel_ops: I can start the quota request — will need the current usage + any existing reservations. kevin, can you paste output of `az vm list-usage --location northeurope -o table` and `az vm list-skus --location northeurope --size ND* -o table`?

kevin.m: pasted info below.
```
# az vm list-usage --location northeurope -o table
Name                     CurrentValue  Limit
Total Regional vCPUs     512           1024
Standard_ND40rs_v2      0             10
Standard_NC24s_v3       2             10
```
```
# az vm list-skus --location northeurope --size ND* -o table
Name                 Tier   Size
Standard_ND40rs_v2   Standard ND40rs_v2
Standard_ND96asr_v4  Standard ND96asr_v4
```

miguel_ops: ok, quota shows Limit=10 for ND40rs_v2 so requesting 8 should be within max but we still need a capacity reservation because available capacity can be 0. I'll open an Azure support case for both a regional quota increase and a capacity reservation / capacity planning ask.

ops-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-2025-412 with priority P1 (customer demo). Assigned: miguel_ops, raj_patel.

miguel_ops: Opening the azure support case now — will link the case id here when I have it. Also recommending we prepare a fallback plan to run on Dedicated pool in westeurope if northeurope fails. That will increase egress cost but keeps demo safe.

nina.s: please add cost estimate for fallback before we commit to reservation. rough numbers ok (gpu-hour * 8 * 4hr).

raj_patel: FYI I checked spot vs reserved capacity — spot won't work for demo. Reservation via Marketplace or Capacity Reservation API is necessary.

miguel_ops: MS support case opened: CS0129987654. Submitted payload: subscription id, resource group placeholder, requested sku Standard_ND40rs_v2, quantity 8, preferred availability zone none (single pool), requested start 2025-11-08, end 2026-05-08.

kevin.m: thanks. Any idea on expected lead time from MS?

miguel_ops: note from previous cases: quota increases are often 24-72h, capacity reservations depend — sometimes >1 week if stock constrained. I'm asking for expedited handling due to customer demo. I've flagged for escalation in the request.

ops-bot: Microsoft response received (automated): Case CS0129987654 — initial review complete. Engineer notes: "We need subscription owner confirmation and workload details; regional inventory check in progress." Reply link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/MSSupport/CaseDetails/caseId/CS0129987654 :eyes:

kevin.m: I replied with confirmation and workload doc link: https://redwood-internal/special-projects/pocto/demo-runbook.

nina.s: miguel, can you also add a temporary quota trick — create a new subscription under our CSP partner and request a small burst there if needed? Might be faster but has billing implications.

miguel_ops: noted. I'll contact partner ops after we hear back from MS. Also starting a parallel ticket with our CSP to check immediate short-term capacity.

oncall-roster: Quick checklist from oncall: 1) Ensure infra-az network quotas (IP addresses) are ok for 8 new VMs, 2) Make sure VNet / NSG rules allow SSH on jumpbox, 3) Pre-bake images in staging to avoid long boot times.

kevin.m: checklist done except IP limit — I'll confirm with networking.

raj_patel: added a small troubleshooting snippet to INFRA-2025-412: if reservation request fails, we can fallback to packing 4x ND96 nodes (higher capacity per node) — might reduce scheduling friction.

miguel_ops: MS just updated case: "Inventory checked — currently limited availability for ND40rs_v2 in northeurope; suggested alternative SKUs: Standard_ND96asr_v4 or Standard_NC24s_v3. Will we accept alternatives?"

kevin.m: ND96asr_v4 is fine as long as we validate performance for our MLP inference. I can run a quick throughput test on one ND96 node.

nina.s: please run perf test and post results latest by Mon EOD so we can accept the change if needed.

miguel_ops: Microsoft asked to confirm whether we want them to proceed reserving ND96asr_v4 ×8 — if we approve they'll allocate and bill against subscription. What do folks say?

kevin.m: Approve ND96asr_v4 ×8 as fallback if ND40rs_v2 unavailable. Please proceed, miguel. :thumbsup:

raj_patel: tagging finance — @nina.s will confirm budget, but this is expected.

ops-bot: INFRA-2025-412 updated: Microsoft provisional allocation requested for Standard_ND96asr_v4 ×8. Waiting final approval and subscription owner confirmation.

miguel_ops: I'll hold off final confirmation until we get cost ack from finance and perf test. If MS needs an immediate yes we'll tell them to provision ND96asr_v4 as it's the safest bet to meet demo deadline.

kevin.m: perf test queued; will post numbers here. thanks all. :rocket:

miguel_ops: follow-up: created CSP partner ticket PARTNER-2025-88 to check burst capacity and pricing. linking here in case MS takes >72h.

kevin.m: perf test results: ND96asr_v4 single-node inference average p50 latency 42ms, throughput 260 tokens/s (on our benchmark). Looks acceptable.

nina.s: finance confirms provisional spend in the PoC budget. approve allocation if MS can provision in time.

ops-bot: CS0129987654 updated: Microsoft has provisionally reserved capacity pending subscription owner confirmation. MSP contact: sara.m@microsoft.com. Next update expected within 12 hours.

miguel_ops: marking INFRA-2025-412 as in-progress. will escalate if no final confirmation by 2025-11-07 18:00 CET.

kevin.m: great, keeping this thread for final signoff. If anything changes I'll ping here.

nina.s: thanks everyone.

oncall-roster: closing note: please add final case id and reservation IDs to the runbook and INFRA ticket once received.
